# stb (vendored)

`stb_image.h` v2.30 and `stb_image_write.h` v1.16 from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit
a7d4c2175630e1ea5b6f8dd00ab96fed0b97b96d, unmodified. License: public domain or MIT (see
`LICENSE`). Built only through `src/texpack_stb.c` (PNG only), used for texture dumps and
replacement packs (`src/texpack.c`).
